question: Choose the word that is the antonym of Generous.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Stingy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Generous"** means showing kindness and a willingness to give more of something, such as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example:** She is generous with her time and often volunteers to help others.
 
 
 
• **"Stingy"** refers to someone who is unwilling to spend or give, often to the point of being miserly. (कंजूस)
 
 
• **Example:** He is so stingy that he refuses to buy a gift for his friend's birthday.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Generous"** is **"Stingy"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Stingy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Kind** (दयालु): Someone who is considerate and caring towards others.
 
 
• **Example:** She is kind to everyone she meets, always offering a helping hand.
 
 
 
• **Benevolent** (सद्भावपूर्ण): Well-meaning and kindly, often associated with charitable acts.
 
 
• **Example:** The benevolent ruler established schools and hospitals for his people.
 
 
 
• **Charitable** (परोपकारी): Relating to the giving of help, especially to those in need.
 
 
• **Example:** She donated a large sum of money to charitable organizations.
